title: Shokunin Ship Manifest
description: Single source of truth for a project's CI/CD pipeline (pcdev -> forge). Locked after ship-gateway elicitation; changes require an ADR. Validated by scripts/check-ship-config.mjs.

versioning.description: Locked decision D1: changesets for every project shape, monolith included.

url.description: Required when provider=custom. For ghcr/gitlab, derived from forge variables if omitted.

sharedPaths.description: Paths whose change impacts ALL services (blast radius). Empty for monolith.

services.description: Monolith: exactly one entry (conventionally 'app' with path '.'). Monorepo: one entry per deployable service.

path.description: Relative path from repo root. '.' for monolith.

package.description: false = this service is built but never dockerized (e.g. node-lib).

structure.description: check-shokunin-structure --strict. Never disabled (D5: guard is blocking).

coverageMin.description: Replaces the hardcoded 75/80 thresholds of the legacy pipelines.

e2e.description: Locked decision D2: on_mr (L), nightly (M), off (S).

package.description: false in profile S: build artifact is enough, no docker stage.

docs.description: Locked decision Q2: docs job triggered by tag, human-enabled here. S: false. M: build. L: build+publish (delivery gate).
